description: Hashes of key input files for Phase T preregistration. Files that will be hashed at WP1 freeze time are marked PENDING_HASH.

PENDING_HASH (to be created at WP1 freeze)

notes: All PENDING_HASH values MUST be computed and recorded before WP1 holdout inference begins.
The hash verification step is logged in reports/phaseT_wp1_run_metadata.json.
If any hash differs from the preregistered value, the holdout run is BLOCKED until the discrepancy is resolved and re-hashed.
The phaseR_*.yaml frozen configs are inherited from Phase R and reused as-is in Phase T.
